title: OhCamel exposure overlay, v1
description: The research layer's exposure scale for the desk: one number in [0, 1] that multiplies every incubation and live target, with the inputs it was computed from. See interface/README.md, section "Overlay", for rules O1-O4.

as_of.description: The instant, RFC 3339 UTC, the overlay was computed for. Checked against the venue clock (O2).

computed_at.description: Wall-clock time of computation, RFC 3339 UTC. Informational.

sequence.description: Monotonic. At or below the last accepted sequence is rejected (O3).

exposure_scale.description: Multiplier on every incubation and live target (O4).

vol_target.description: Annualised volatility the book aims for.

vol_artifact.description: Id of the stored volatility model artifact.

cov_artifact.description: Id of the stored covariance artifact.

reported.description: Figures the page shows and the desk does not act on, e.g. regime_p_high, mc_var_99_1d_core.
